arguments.title: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Methodology for Video Object Segmentation
key_claims: Region IoU, boundary quality and temporal stability measure different failure modes. The paper cautions that occlusions and strong deformations can be mistaken for instability. Thus smoother masks alone cannot qualify LightSem targets. Report independent human-mask IoU/boundaries and errors in the retained color distribution, grouped by source-song family. Borrow the evaluation distinctions without claiming that DAVIS performance transfers to stylized choreography backgrounds or downloading an unrelated dataset.
